title: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following') (CWE-59) in Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) can lead to…
description: Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) suffers from an improper link resolution vulnerability (CWE-59) that can allow an attacker with high privileges on the host to bypass authentication and make unauthorized configuration changes to other deployments on the same host by exploiting symbolic link (symlink) attacks.
